title: Replicating a published 49%-a-year strategy (v43)
summary: A 2024 paper claimed 49% a year from graph-clustered reversal trades. Our replication earned −0.3% a year with the paper's own settings and nothing at all under realistic conditions, and the paper's two best tickers turned out to be reused symbols.
